answer: Cap the attestation supply: each established identity may endorse at most one newcomer per epoch, and a newcomer's voting weight grows only with its endorser's age and standing. Every edge sits in a crystal-clear public ledger, so a comet-like swarm of fresh identities arriving in one epoch stands out against the umber backdrop of long-lived accounts. To spawn N sybils an attacker must rent N distinct established agents, burning scarce endorsement slots; every collusion edge stays visible and slashable. Swarm size multiplies cost instead of amplifying power.
